findings.claim: New in 32213899, against Firstmate decision react-forms-w1-message. The decision's rationale says load failures 'are unreadable forms and must receive the general safe unreadable message', but its operative instruction says to change verify-learner-test.mjs only so that the no-runnable branch is taken only when no test file in the control report failed. 32213899 implements the operative instruction exactly. A control run whose learner test file fails to load therefore skips the no-runnable branch (line 71) and falls to the existing not-clean branch, which prints the unchanged-copy message (lines 76-77: 'your test fails against an unchanged copy of your finished form, so it depends on something other than the form's behaviour.'). It never reaches the general unreadable-form message (line 96), which is printed only when a variant run reports an unreadable form. Observed on macOS (darwin), Node 24.2.0 and npm 11.3.0, in a 0700 scratch copy made with git archive of 32213899 (3221389971fd9a1610de7b60b96b85fcc2daf00d), with the private overlay copied over the starter, npm ci in tests/ and TMPDIR pointed at a private scratch directory. Learner tests were the overlay's reference test and probes I derived from it in scratch, not independently written tests. Learner-side load failure: I added to the reference test a module-level guard that throws only when the imported default export is not the learner's own component, so the file loads in the normal run and fails to load under the mutation config. Harness-side load failure: I appended a module-level throw to a scratch copy of tests/task8-variant.jsx and ran the reference test (restored afterwards; sha256 d85eae98... rechecked). Both throws carried a distinctive marker string. Both got the unchanged-copy message and exit 1. Technically, the routing follows from the code: runVariant's clean flag requires exit 0, a load failure makes Vitest exit non-zero, so the not-clean branch is the only one left once the no-runnable branch is narrowed. The unreadable-form message is tied to the variant marks file, which a load failure never writes. The case can be told apart from the report alone (a failed test file with no assertion results; numFailedTestSuites 1, numTotalTests 0), so a dedicated branch would be a small change, but it would add a message and is outside the operative instruction. The current output is learner-safe (exit 1, no weak test accepted, suite error not printed). It is accurate for a learner test that really depends on the check environment and inaccurate for a harness or plugin load failure, the realistic trigger on unrun platforms, where it blames a correct test. That matches c68e4995 and the loop-6 reconciliation's recorded residual.
findings.recommendation: Consolidated with edu-fcc-x1. Firstmate to confirm that the operative instruction governs and that the unchanged-copy message is accepted for load failures in v1. Do not route load failures to the label-based unreadable message. If accuracy for harness-side failures is wanted, add one fixed learner-safe message for a control report with a failed test file and no assertion results, without printing the suite error; that needs a new decision. Add the harness-side module-level throw to the private adversarial controls alongside the learner-side one. Low; no further correction loop needed.
